entries.name: openfreemap
entries.reason: map tiles fetched by the browser, no key; a failed load shows the map-down message and is not counted server-side

entries.name: motorfix_maintenance_refusals_total
entries.reason: counts calls refused while maintenance is on, by route and role (visitor or signed_in); ST-879 adds the dashboard, ST-880 the alerts

entries.name: motorfix_platform_rule_changes_total
entries.reason: counts rule change requests by action (requested, approved, refused, cancelled), with one PlatformRuleChanges log line per step; ST-880 adds the alerts

entries.name: grafana-faro
entries.reason: the browser's collector; ST-880 adds the alerts

entries.name: keycloak
entries.reason: the identity server signing-key fetch, host read from ASSISTANT_ISSUER; counted in mcp_key_fetches_total{outcome} on the mcp dashboard; a failed fetch fires mcp-key-fetch-failures, and calls answer 503 (not counted as sign-in failures); the IssuerProbe reads its discovery document once a minute into mcp_issuer_up, which fires mcp-issuer-unreachable

entries.name: mcp_tool_calls_total{tool=~"list_quote_requests|get_schedule|get_day_sheet|get_stats"}
entries.reason: the four garage read tools count under mcp_tool_calls_total{tool,outcome} and mcp_tool_call_duration_seconds{tool}, one McpToolCall log line and an mcp.tool <name> span per call, like every tool; the existing mcp-tool-errors alert sums every tool; reads write no audit row

entries.name: motorfix_garage_profile_cache_total
entries.reason: counts the public profile cache by outcome (hit, miss, drop); ST-880 adds the alerts

entries.name: motorfix_quote_requests_sent_total
entries.reason: counts quote requests sent by outcome (sent with its recipients, cannot_receive, limit, invalid — invalid counts the use case's own refusals, not the validation pipe's or a missing Idempotency-Key), with one log line per send naming the outcome and the request id; ST-880 adds the alert rules

entries.name: motorfix_request_received_total
entries.reason: counts each garage a new request reaches by outcome (built, muted, skipped), with one log line per event naming the request id and how many staff it reached; no agreed threshold yet, ST-880 adds the alert rules

entries.name: motorfix_quotes_sent_total
entries.reason: counts quotes garages send by outcome (sent, refused, already_answered, request_not_open; refused covers the service's own 400, 403 and 404, the validation pipe's 400s show in the route metric) and records motorfix_quote_response_minutes (request created to quote sent) with no identifiers, with one Quotes log line per send naming the quote id, the request id and the outcome; no agreed threshold yet, ST-880 adds the alert rules

entries.name: motorfix_quote_received_total
entries.reason: counts each sent quote announced to its driver by outcome (built, muted), with the fan-out's log line naming the quote id; also on motorfix-product; no agreed threshold yet, ST-880 adds the alert rules

entries.name: quote-requests
entries.reason: ST-880 adds the alerts

entries.name: quotes
entries.reason: one log line per send naming the quote id, the request id and the outcome; the send counter and response-time histogram are the motorfix_quotes_sent_total entry; no agreed threshold yet, ST-880 adds the alerts

entries.name: garage-job-steps
entries.reason: each refusal logs one 'job step refused' line with ids and its code; ST-880 adds the alerts

entries.name: motorfix_job_steps_total
entries.reason: counts step changes by action (added, renamed, reordered, removed, ticked, unticked); ST-880 adds the alerts

entries.name: motorfix_account_changes_total
entries.reason: counts saved changes of an account's own details by field (name, city, email, phone, password); a change count has no failure mode of its own

entries.name: my-details
entries.metric: http.server.request.duration by http.route PATCH /api/v1/me, POST /api/v1/me/email, /api/v1/me/phone, /api/v1/me/phone/confirm and /api/v1/auth/confirm-email (the change link)
entries.reason: each refusal logs one 'phone change refused: <code>' or 'e-mail change link not sent' line, never the address or number; the WhatsApp code goes out through the brevo entry and a failed send logs 'phone code not sent: whatsapp_failed (<kind>)' and answers 502; saved changes are motorfix_account_changes_total; spans come from the HTTP and Prisma auto-instrumentation; ST-880 adds the alerts

entries.name: auth-password
entries.reason: each refusal logs one 'password change refused: <code>' line and a failed notice e-mail logs 'password changed e-mail not sent'; a saved change counts on motorfix_account_changes_total{field="password"}; ST-880 adds the alerts

entries.name: garage-reports
entries.reason: refusals show on the request-duration metric by route and status code; ST-880 adds the alerts

entries.name: motorfix_garage_reports_total
entries.reason: outcomes created, already_reported and refused (both 409); 404 and 429 read from the request-duration metric by route and status; ST-880 adds the alert rules

entries.name: listing-documents
entries.reason: ST-880 adds the alerts; a page left in storage after a failed delete logs one warning with the draft id and key

entries.name: admin-verification-documents
entries.reason: ST-880 adds the alerts; each issued address writes one open entry in the history and counts motorfix_documents_opened_total

entries.name: motorfix_documents_uploaded_total
entries.reason: counts each confirmed document page by kind (onrc_certificate, rar_authorisation); ST-880 adds the alerts

entries.name: motorfix_declarations_signed_total
entries.reason: counts each signed declaration; ST-880 adds the alerts

entries.name: motorfix_documents_opened_total
entries.reason: counts each time an admin opens a document page, by kind; ST-880 adds the alerts
